name: sem-sw-ticket-system
description: SEM SW Ticket System - starter application template built on the SEM SW common web platform.

scripts.workspace:refresh: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/ensure-platform-root.cjs && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/assert-local-dev-env.cjs
scripts.deps:ci: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm ci --ignore-scripts --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-audit --no-fund && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run workspace:refresh && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run postinstall
scripts.preinstall: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/ensure-platform-root.cjs && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/assert-local-dev-env.cjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/install-platform.cjs && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs scripts/verify-platform-sync.cjs
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && node ../scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --build --pretty false && node ../scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --emptyOutDir=false
scripts.dev: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run workspace:refresh && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run postinstall && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run build:shared && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.verify: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run test && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run build
scripts.verify:release: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run verify && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run verify:production-migrations && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run budget:frontend
scripts.build: node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run workspace:refresh && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run postinstall && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run build:shared && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run build --workspace backend && node scripts/invoke-workspace-node.cjs --npm run build:frontend
